description: Make a printable handwriting tracing worksheet: names, words or short sentences in dotted or gray letters to trace, on handwriting lines, in print or cursive. Perfect for a child’s name, sight words or letters. Up to 20 lines of up to 30 characters.

blank_row.description: Add an empty row after each, to write on their own.

decoration.description: A themed border with matching pictures, drawn around the sheet: "line" for a plain border, "none" for nothing, or a theme such as halloween, christmas, thanksgiving, spring, dinosaurs, space, ocean, animals, birthday, back-to-school (95 themes; find_printables shows a theme’s name). Leave out for no border.

dyslexia_font.description: Print in OpenDyslexic, a typeface some readers with dyslexia find easier.

letter_case.description: As typed, all upper or all lower case.

lines.description: What to trace, one line each (a name, a word or a short sentence). Every line, a name included, is part of the link.

model.description: Start each row with a solid model to copy.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, the default; US and Canada) or a4 (everywhere else).

repeat.description: Repeat the word along the row.

rows_per_line.description: How many tracing rows each line gets (0 fills the page).

size.description: Letter size: large (preschool), medium or small.

style.description: dots: dotted letters; gray: light gray letters to trace over.

title.description: The title printed at the top of the sheet, e.g. "Practice My Name". Keep it short.

name: make_tracing_worksheet

maker.description: Which maker drew it, e.g. wordSearch

notes.description: Things worth knowing about this sheet

playUrl.description: Where a child can solve it on a screen (word search, crossword, maze, sudoku)

seed.description: The seed that rebuilds this exact sheet

settings.description: The address settings, as the maker reads them

url.description: The sheet on printablesmith.com, every setting filled in: open it to adjust, download the PDF or print

title: Tracing worksheet
